01

“so walk among its slopes”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 67:15).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid, on His saying:
so walk among its slopes [al-Mulk: 15], meaning: "in its regions and its broad passes."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَامْشُوا فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا [الملك: 15] ، يَعْنِي: «فِي أَطْرَافِهَا وَفِجَاجِهَا»
Edition record 373643 · p. 667Link to report ↗
02

“above them with wings spread”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 67:19).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
above them with wings spread [al-Mulk: 19], he said: "Al-ṣāffāt: the spreading of their wings, their flapping [taladhdhuʿ, as printed], and their folding them."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَوْقَهُمْ صَافَّاتٍ [الملك: 19] قَالَ: " الصَّافَّاتُ: بَسْطُ أَجْنِحَتِهِنَّ، وَتَلَذُّعُهُنَّ وَقَبْضُهُنَّ "
Edition record 373644 · p. 667Link to report ↗
03

“Rather, they persist in insolence and aversion”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 67:21).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
Rather, they persist in insolence and aversion [al-Mulk: 21], he said: "Aversion (nufūr): disbelief (kufūr)."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
بَلْ لَجُّوا فِي عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ [الملك: 21] قَالَ: " النُّفُورُ: الْكُفُورُ "
Edition record 373645 · p. 667Link to report ↗
04

“falling prone on his face”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 67:22).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
falling prone on his face [al-Mulk: 22], meaning: "in misguidance"; Is he who walks upright on a straight path [al-Mulk: 22], meaning: "upon the straight truth."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
مُكِبًّا عَلَى وَجْهِهِ [الملك: 22] ، يَعْنِي: «فِي الضَّلَالَةِ» ، أَمَّنْ يَمْشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ [الملك: 22] ، يَعْنِي: «عَلَى الْحَقِّ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ»
Edition record 373646 · p. 667Link to report ↗
05

“But when they see it near”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 67:27).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
But when they see it near [al-Mulk: 27], he says: "They saw that it had drawn near."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً [الملك: 27] يَقُولُ: «رَأَوْهُ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ»
Edition record 373647 · p. 667Link to report ↗
06

“who then can bring you flowing water?”

An explanation transmitted from ʿIkrima (Q 67:30).

06
Explanation from ʿIkrima 06

ʿIkrima

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Shaybān narrated to us, from Jābir, from ʿIkrima:
who then can bring you flowing water? [al-Mulk: 30], he said: "Al-maʿīn: the manifest."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ:
فَمَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمْ بِمَاءٍ مَعِينٍ [الملك: 30] قَالَ: " الْمَعِينُ: الظَّاهِرُ "
Edition record 373648 · p. 667Link to report ↗
